title: Facts You Won't Believe Are True
hook: Honey found in ancient Egyptian tombs is still edible!
script: Honey found in ancient Egyptian tombs is still perfectly edible after thousands of years. That's right, it literally never spoils! And get this: a group of owls isn't called a flock, it's called a parliament. How fancy is that? But here’s one that will really blow your mind: a single cloud can weigh over a million pounds. Imagine that much water vapor just floating around! It's incredible to think about the secrets our world holds, like how honey from ancient Egyptian tombs remains perfectly edible after thousands of years.
comment: What's the most unbelievable fact you know?
description:
Dive into some truly mind-blowing facts that will make you question everything you thought you knew! From ancient secrets to natural wonders, prepare to be amazed. 
#AmazingFacts #DidYouKnow #MindBlown
source_topic: 91 Unbelievable Facts That You’ll Never Forget!
